metric_definitions.official_score: Upstream OOLONG score on [0,1]; numeric score is 0.75**abs(error)
metric_definitions.parsed_exact_match: Official answer-parser strict equality, separate from full credit
metric_definitions.denominator: 12 per requested model, including failed, empty and unknown outcomes
metric_definitions.source_count: Exact complete Responses source-text input envelope, including formatting; not Qwen raw-text tokenizer tokens
metric_definitions.direct_count: Exact full direct prompt with budget notice; admission adds 16 safety tokens and the separately reported output reserve
metric_definitions.sampling_units: The same 12 distinct source contexts are reused across models; distinct IDs and hashes do not establish statistical independence, and 36 model/sample pairs are not 36 independent observations
metric_definitions.wilson_interval: Descriptive nominal 95% Wilson intervals using 12 context units per model; underlying record overlap and dependence are not excluded

capacity_definition.native_source: Official model metadata verified before run; distinct from the actively imposed 16k window

gpt-6-sol.definition: Direct admission input including safety margin plus recorded output reserve exceeds 1050000
gpt-6-sol.interpretation: Descriptive token-capacity-defined subgroup, separate from all 12; no direct-answer comparison

gpt-6-luna.definition: Direct admission input including safety margin plus recorded output reserve exceeds 1050000
gpt-6-luna.interpretation: Descriptive token-capacity-defined subgroup, separate from all 12; no direct-answer comparison

gpt-6.1-terra.definition: Direct admission input including safety margin plus recorded output reserve exceeds 1050000
gpt-6.1-terra.interpretation: Descriptive token-capacity-defined subgroup, separate from all 12; no direct-answer comparison

cost.definition: Conservative model-generation estimate, NOT an invoice
cost.known_usage: (actual_input + actual_output) * r_max / 1e6; base I/O estimate shown separately
cost.unknown_delivery: Entire monetary and token reservation retained
cost.cache_and_reasoning_details: Subsets of input/output, never added twice
cost.count_requests: Audited separately; not generation calls or generation-token usage

minimal_api_availability_probe.provenance: Parent-task reported three minimal API probes

integrity.os_guard_limit: Probe/profile verification, not a complete OS file-access trace

limitations: Previously consumed cohort 5 transfer replay, not a new blind holdout
One run per model/source and 12 distinct source contexts; statistical independence is not established and model/sample pairs are not pooled as n=36 independent observations
Harness-only generation: no causal uplift estimate against direct, RAG, RLM or MemGPT
Direct checks measure capacity/admission only; rejection is not a wrong semantic answer
Native weights and attention windows are unchanged; source envelopes differ from Qwen raw token counts
No new RLM/MemGPT comparison or official leaderboard submission
Public-data pretraining contamination and underlying record overlap are not excluded
Plan, unknown-count and stop counters do not independently verify semantic labels or prove why a record remained unknown
